annotations.title: readm3: Read a document at a URL

description:
[readm3] Fetch a document by URL and return its text: PDFs (arXiv papers, reports), web pages, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, EPUB, Markdown and other text. Use it to summarize, quote or answer questions about a link. Returns title, kind, page count, character count, whether the text was truncated, and the text. maxChars caps the text (default 100,000, up to 400,000). No account needed; a free hourly allowance, then an x402 reader pass.

Served by readm3 (https://readm3.com/docs).
